annotation.title_clean: The Proposed Regulation of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Kenya: An Appraisal of the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023
annotation.title_en: The Proposed Regulation of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Kenya: An Appraisal of the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023
annotation.summary_en: Journal article appraising Kenya's Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023. It reviews global regulatory trends, notes merits such as creating a professional body, criticises limited scope, lack of guiding principles and weak enforcement, and proposes amendments: principles, enforcement powers, mandatory AI inventory and disclosure, and inter-agency collaboration.
key_provisions_or_claims: The bill creates a professional association that advises government and formulates industry standards.
The bill has limited regulatory scope and no enforcement powers.
The bill lacks clear guiding regulatory principles.
Recommends mandatory AI system inventory and disclosure.
Recommends mandatory inter-agency collaboration and stronger enforcement, drawing on global best practice.
